CustomField.description: Working Days excluding Weekends and holidays. YTD Holiday count is manually managed via Custom Label - HolidayTracker. This formula calculates the nos of days b/w 2 days
CustomField.formula: (5 * ( FLOOR( ( Today() - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( Today() - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) ) - (5 * ( FLOOR( ( YTD_Start_Date__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( YTD_Start_Date__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) ) + 1 - VALUE($Label.HolidayTracker)
CustomField.label: Working Days YTD
